name: Subconscious meal feedback (ask + ingest)
notes: Hourly during waking hours. PRODUCE: enqueue 'How was <dish>?' pending_questions for recent past meals (the conversation_starter bridge asks them proactively). INGEST: turn the user's chat reply into a feedback.comment pod -> feedback_extractor -> beliefs. Closes the ask->answer->belief loop. CLI: python -m app.assistant.subconscious.run_meal_feedback.
